articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Expanded Context and Reasoning Upgrades
articles.summary: Anthropic unveiled Claude 4 this week, featuring a 2 million token context window and significantly improved multi-step reasoning capabilities. The model outperforms previous benchmarks on complex coding and scientific tasks. The release includes both a consumer-facing version and an API tier aimed at enterprise deployments.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Autonomous Agent Platform for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI announced a new enterprise-focused agentic platform that allows companies to deploy AI agents capable of managing multi-step business workflows without human intervention. The platform integrates with major enterprise tools including Salesforce, SAP, and Microsoft 365. Early adopters report up to 40% reduction in manual administrative tasks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Top Scores on Medical Licensing Exams
articles.summary: Google DeepMind published research showing Gemini Ultra 2 scoring in the 97th percentile on the USMLE and equivalent medical exams across five countries. The model demonstrated strong multimodal diagnostic reasoning, combining radiology images with patient histories. Researchers caution the results reflect benchmark performance and not readiness for clinical deployment.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fines to Three Tech Firms
articles.summary: The newly empowered EU AI Office issued its first enforcement actions under the AI Act, fining three unnamed technology companies a combined €340 million for deploying high-risk AI systems without required conformity assessments. The fines signal a shift from the act's transitional grace period into active regulatory enforcement. Industry groups are calling for clearer guidance on compliance standards.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source RAG Framework LlamaIndex 3.0 with Native Tool Use
articles.summary: Meta and the open-source community officially released LlamaIndex 3.0, a major overhaul of the popular retrieval-augmented generation framework now featuring native tool-calling integrations and improved vector store connectors. The update supports seamless hybrid search combining dense and sparse retrieval methods. Developer adoption has surged with over 50,000 GitHub stars in the first 48 hours.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Accelerating AI-Driven Misinformation Ahead of 2026 Midterms
articles.summary: Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute released its annual report highlighting a sharp rise in AI-generated political misinformation campaigns in the lead-up to U.S. midterm elections. Researchers documented over 1,200 coordinated inauthentic influence operations using synthetic media in the past six months. The report urges platforms to adopt mandatory AI content provenance labeling.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Adds Real-Time Voice Multimodal Capabilities
articles.summary: Microsoft expanded its Copilot Studio platform with real-time voice and visual input processing, allowing enterprise bots to handle spoken queries while simultaneously analyzing shared screens or documents. The update leverages GPT-5 under the hood and is rolling out to commercial tenants globally. Microsoft claims the feature reduces customer support call resolution times by an average of 28%.

articles.title: Mistral AI Unveils Mistral Edge, a 3B Parameter Model Optimized for On-Device Inference
articles.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI announced Mistral Edge, a compact 3-billion parameter model designed to run efficiently on smartphones and edge hardware without cloud connectivity. The model achieves competitive performance on instruction-following tasks while consuming under 4GB of memory. Mistral says the release targets healthcare and industrial IoT use cases where data privacy and offline operation are critical.
